item.title: Fire emerges at Winter Garden recycling facility
item.description: AMT Recycling LLC experienced a fire in its front yard Tuesday, Feb. 24. Winter Garden Fire Rescue Department is on scene right now.

item.title: Orange County mayor gives feds deadline to resolve reimbursement issues
item.description: Orange County Mayor Jerry Demings sent a letter out to U.S. Marshals Service grant specialist regarding reimbursement to house federal inmates.

item.title: Florida House votes 80-30 to advance tax exemption for homestead properties
item.description: Lawmakers approved an amended resolution Thursday, Feb. 19, to eliminate taxes for homestead properties.

item.title: Rosen JCC announces new director of development and foundation relations
item.description: Stacey Weiss brings more than a decade of experience in the community to Rosen JCC.

item.description: The Ocoee City Commission heard the Ocoee Middle School project updates and expressed concerns for the attention to residents.

item.title: 41 rooms in 24 hours: Local escape room enthusiasts break world record
item.description: Five Central Florida escape room enthusiasts break the world record of escape rooms completed in 24 hours.

item.title: Horizon West Regional Park will be area’s ‘crown jewel’
item.description: The county celebrated the completion and opening of the park’s first phase with a ribbon-cutting. There is much more to come.

item.title: Windermere Prep raises more than $35k for American Heart Association
item.description: Windermere Preparatory School announced the school raised the most amount it ever has raised for this cause.
